scoring_justification: Compute-driven MD task; the verifier sandbox cannot re-run the full LAMMPS simulation. The output contract exposes only final extracted property CSVs, not raw stress-strain curves. Therefore T1 recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible. We compare the agent's reported values to paper-reported hidden gold with tolerances and verify physically required monotonic trends.

outputs.description: Mechanical properties of pristine h-BN and two GB models under baseline conditions (300 K, 1×10^8 s⁻¹).
Ultimate tensile strength of GB (2,1)|(1,2) at three strain rates.
Ultimate tensile strength of GB (2,1)|(1,2) at three temperatures.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares the reported mechanical properties to paper-reported reference values with tolerances and verifies that the ultimate tensile strength exhibits the expected monotonic trends (increasing with strain rate, decreasing with temperature). No hidden gold values or tolerances are disclosed in the public contract.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for pristine and GB mechanical properties (pristine_gb_properties.csv)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (pristine h-BN zz/am values) and Table 3 models 1 and 14 (GB (1,3)|(3,1) and GB (6,5)|(5,6))
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the paper's reported Tersoff MD simulation results
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed values for the exact Tersoff potential and conditions the agent is instructed to use

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference UTS values for strain rate effect (strain_rate_effect.csv)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 model 10 (τ=77 GPa at 1e8 s⁻¹) and Figure 5(a) text description (τ≈80 GPa at 1e9 s⁻¹, τ≈199 GPa at 1e10 s⁻¹)
hidden_assets.generation_method: 1e8 from Table 3; 1e9 and 1e10 read from the paper's narrative description of strain-rate dependence
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported UTS values for GB (2,1)|(1,2) at the three specified strain rates

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference UTS values for temperature effect (temperature_effect.csv)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 model 10 (τ=77 GPa at 300 K) and Figure 5(c) narrative (τ=98 GPa at 1 K, τ=43 GPa at 1100 K)
hidden_assets.generation_method: 300 K from Table 3; 1 K and 1100 K read from the paper's narrative description of temperature dependence
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported UTS values for GB (2,1)|(1,2) at the three specified temperatures

steps.description: Verify baseline mechanical properties for pristine h-BN (zz/am) and two GB models against paper reported values with tolerances, plus structural trend checks
Verify UTS of GB (2,1)|(1,2) at three strain rates against paper values, plus monotonic increase trend
Verify UTS of GB (2,1)|(1,2) at three temperatures against paper values, plus monotonic decrease trend
